name: Engineering Implementation
description: Pick up a Jira story, read the spec/ERD, plan the implementation, create a branch, write the code, run tests, and open a PR.

jiraStoryId.description: Jira story ID to implement (e.g. KOS-42)

repoPath.description: Path to the repository root (defaults to current directory)

config.prompt_template:
You are reading a Jira story and its linked specification documents.

Jira Story:
{{fetch_story}}

Instructions:
1. Extract the acceptance criteria, requirements, and any linked ERD/spec documents.
2. Identify the affected domain models, API endpoints, and UI components.
3. List all files that will likely need to be created or modified.
4. Note any dependencies on other stories or external services.

Output a structured analysis with sections: Requirements, Affected Components, File Plan, Dependencies, and Open Questions.

config.decision_prompt:
Based on the story analysis below, decide the implementation approach.

Story Analysis:
{{read_spec}}

Consider:
- Is this a new feature, a modification to existing code, or a refactor?
- Does it require database migrations?
- What is the testing strategy (unit, integration, e2e)?

options.label: Greenfield Implementation
options.description: New domain/feature with fresh files, schema changes, and new tests

options.label: Modify Existing Code
options.description: Changes to existing files with backward compatibility, incremental tests

options.label: Refactor Then Implement
options.description: Restructure existing code before adding the new behavior

config.prompt_template:
You are a senior engineer writing an implementation plan.

Story Analysis:
{{read_spec}}

Approach: {{plan_approach}}

Write a step-by-step implementation plan with:
1. Database schema changes (if any) with exact Prisma model definitions
2. Core domain logic: entity classes, value objects, business rules
3. Application layer: use cases with input/output contracts
4. Capability classes: persistence, auth, events as needed
5. Interface layer: API route handlers with request/response shapes
6. Test plan: what to test at each layer, with example test names

For each file, specify the full path, whether it is new or modified, and a brief description of changes.

config.decision_prompt:
Review the test output and determine the next step.

Test Output:
{{run_tests}}

Are all tests passing? Are there any failures that need to be fixed before opening a PR?

options.label: All Tests Pass
options.description: All tests green, ready to open PR

options.label: Tests Failing
options.description: One or more tests failed, needs debugging and fixes
